data.one_liner: A Flutter framework that uses code generation to scaffold apps with built‑in state, routing, forms and theming.
data.what_it_does: Masamune generates boilerplate for routing, state management, database adapters, theming and forms via build_runner. It provides a CLI to create projects and watch code changes, reducing manual coding effort.
use_when: You need rapid app scaffolding with consistent architecture
You want type‑safe generated code for routing, state and forms
You prefer a CLI‑driven workflow with automatic rebuilds
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained custom logic that the generated code may restrict
You want a lightweight solution without many dependencies
strengths: Consistent, type‑safe architecture across the app
Integrated support for routing, storage, auth and theming
weaknesses: Heavy reliance on build_runner and many packages
Steep learning curve for the framework and CLI
data.setup_notes: Install katana_cli globally, add masamune plus json_annotation, freezed_annotation, build_runner, masamune_builder, json_serializable, freezed; run katana create and katana code watch

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar code‑generation for immutable models without the full framework

alternatives.name: hooks
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers lightweight state‑management without the heavy scaffolding

alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative code‑gen approach for immutable value types
